items.title: Nvidia, Micron, AMD sink after SK Hynix results fail to impress, AI trade unwinds

items.title: The CLARITY Act divides finance giants ahead of congressional recess
items.summary: Scott Melker breaks down the growing divide on Wall Street over the CLARITY Act, as BlackRock (BLK), Fidelity (FIS), Goldman Sachs (GS), and SoFi (SOFI) publicly back the crypto market structure bill just one week before Congress heads into recess. Melker also discusses Morgan Stanley (MS) offering new ethereum (ETH-USD), Solana (SOL-USD) ETFs aunds, and what the latest developments mean for investors. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
